name: Sign in and create a business workspace
description: Verifies a signed-in owner can create a private workspace and see it on the dashboard.
steps: Sign in with an available provider
Choose Retail & General Shop and NGN currency
expected: The dashboard opens for Sunday Market and displays its business details.

name: Edit and delete business records
description: Verifies a business owner can update a sale, see the revised amount, and delete a record with confirmation.
steps: Open Sales and record 'Weekend orders' for 12500
Edit it to 'Weekend market orders' and change the amount to 15000
Refresh and confirm the edited record remains
Delete the edited sale and confirm the action
expected: The revised name and amount persist after refresh, and the sale disappears after confirmed deletion.

name: Create, mark paid and print an invoice receipt
description: Verifies an owner can create a customer invoice, mark it paid and open a printable receipt.
steps: Open Invoices and create an invoice for Ada Customer with one item
Confirm the invoice appears with an invoice number and due date
expected: The invoice remains in the list as Paid and a formatted receipt print view opens.

name: Review date-filtered business performance
description: Verifies the Reports page filters sales and expenses by the selected date range and calculates the net result.
steps: Choose a date range that includes existing sales and expenses
Review sales, expenses and net result totals
expected: The report displays totals calculated from records within the selected date range.

name: Track customer balances and manage records on mobile
description: Verifies mobile users can manage customer balances, inventory and expenses.
steps: Open Customers and add Ada Customer with an outstanding balance of 10000
Record a payment of 3000 and confirm 7000 remains
Open Inventory and add Classic Shirt at 8000 with quantity 4
Edit its quantity to 3, then add Packaging expense for 2500
expected: The customer balance, edited stock and new expense are saved and visible after refresh.
